font_empty: No fonts yet — upload some by scanning the QR code
wallpaper_empty: No wallpapers yet — upload some by scanning the QR code
hero_hint_1: What sits behind the big card at the top of the home screen. With Weather installed you can let it take over, or always use a picture.
hero_hint_2: Upload artwork from the Artwork section of the upload page. A banner shape works best — about twice as wide as it is tall.
hero_auto_hint: Shows Weather when it's installed, the built-in artwork otherwise
theme_hint: Change how Space looks: colors, outlines and the home page. Tap one to switch, no restart needed.
